en.name: Vision at Scete
en.summary: A doubting desert monk is said to have seen a child appear on the altar in place of the bread at the Liturgy.
en.body: The Sayings of the Desert Fathers record that a monk of Scete in Egypt who doubted the Real Presence was granted, together with two companions, a vision at the Liturgy of a child seated upon the altar in place of the bread, confirming his faith.
